## 3. What the registry does NOT license

- **It does not make round 4 paste-able.** Round 4 still defines `[^1]`=skills and `[^2]`=Cursor rules, which
  collide with round 2's `[^1]`=hooks and `[^2]`=skills. The checker reports those as **hard KEY COLLISION** rows
  and will keep doing so until someone re-keys round 4 **to round 2's numbers** — which is the repair, and is seat
  work.
- **Three collisions, not two, and round 3 is one of them.** The checker prints them in one table: `[^1]` = round 2
  hooks / round 3 `docs.github.com/…/hooks-reference` / round 4 skills; `[^2]` = round 2 skills / round 3
  `cursor.com/docs/hooks` / round 4 Cursor rules; `[^3]` = round 2 `learn.chatgpt.com/…/config-advanced` / round 3
  `learn.chatgpt.com/docs/hooks`. Round 3 is already labelled **verified**, so a merge must re-key round 3 as well —
  verified-in-the-past does not mean key-compatible, and nobody had recorded round 3's side of this until the
  instrument printed it.
- **`inferred` means the mapping is a guess with a page name behind it, and the checker says so on every run.** Of the
  **15** hex aliases: **8 are inferred** (`20106b 5f6188 3d9c8f dccefb 2d9eb4 04a0b7 d2cffc d3d5bf` — a page name is
  asserted, no URL was ever printed), **6 are confirmed** (`542f21`, `5389e9` by a URL printed in round 4's bytes;
  `d32e06` because its bytes re-fetch byte-identical to MANIFEST's `[^8]` row; plus the three issue aliases `50ad47`,
  `ded888`, `f06a5e`), and **1 — `b736c3` — has no named source in any round.** Each inferred row needs a URL line
  before it may be used (250's *Do not* list), and `ALIAS INFERRED — NEEDS URL (8)` re-appears on every run until then,
  because a soft finding nobody re-runs is a rumor.
- **Do not re-anchor by re-fetching.** `inputs/fetched/MANIFEST.md` §4 measured a byte-identical re-fetch whose
  *locator* had rotted (`features/` → `customization/`), and line ranges do not survive at all: round 4's copies are
  `web_fetch` markdown (476 / 1,073 lines) while the bytes on this host are HTML (514 KB / 286 KB). Re-anchor at the
  clone pin (four of the five harnesses are pinned: `claude-code-docs 58d6da1`, `codex d373d64`, `cline 51f63e4`,
  `goose 775b395`, plus `copilot-cli 84ee80e`), or carry ≤40-word quotes (D159).
